channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Spencer Dinwiddie | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Spencer Dinwiddie from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Anthony Davis on Spencer Dinwiddie scoring 26 points tonight, his most since joining LAL:

“How he played tonight, we’re going to need him to play like that the rest of the season”

Anthony Davis on Spencer Dinwiddie, Mar 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
Ryan Ward:D'Angelo Russell on Spencer Dinwiddie:

“He's super versatile. I mean it's a reason why all the winning teams have had a piece of him and want to use him and utilize him. Here his role may be a little different, but he's more than capable of doing everything for us to win.”

D'Angelo Russell on Spencer Dinwiddie, Mar 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on limiting Dinwiddie' to 20 minutes:

“Overall I've always talked about this being performance-based. I thought tonight, Dennis had a good (night) for us defensively. And we're just in a position right now where you have to perform. That's across the board.”

Jacque Vaughn on Spencer Dinwiddie, Jan 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
But he’s already getting a look at Ben Simmons and Spencer Dinwiddie working together — and seems to like what he’s seen.

“Overall it’s been interesting. Not having Cam available, I’d love to see how he fits with some of the pieces out there. Right now Spencer and Ben have been playing together a bunch,”

Jacque Vaughn on Spencer Dinwiddie, Oct 8, 2023. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on Spencer Dinwiddie:

“I've seen Spencer at the age of 22, 23; now seeing him at the age of 29, 30. And the maturation is to another level, and you have to give him credit for that. And that's just experience.”

Jacque Vaughn on Spencer Dinwiddie, Mar 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Big Sean on Spencer Dinwiddie, Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
“We’re excited to add Spencer and Dorian to our roster, while also securing draft compensation that will increase our flexibility moving forward,”

Big Sean on Spencer Dinwiddie, Dorian Finney-Smith, Feb 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @AdamZagoria.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on Spencer Dinwiddie returning to Brooklyn:

“Spencer is a high-IQ guy, he’ll be able to figure things out quickly. He and I have a good rapport… I think he’ll fit in and be ready to go.”

Jacque Vaughn on Spencer Dinwiddie, Feb 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Javale McGee, Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
Jason Kidd shared, via ESPN.

“… [But] We believe we’re going to be a bigger team. Nothing against JB’s height. With Spencer (Dinwiddie) starting, our starting five is gonna be big with JaVale (McGee)at center. We believe that we’re going to be having a lot more offense coming off the bench.”

Jason Kidd on Javale McGee, Spencer Dinwiddie, Jul 8, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Steve Nash on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
But Nash won’t talk about the possibility of Dinwiddie returning this season for fear of putting any undue pressure on the Nets guard.

“I haven’t messaged with him for a few weeks now. I think he’s in L.A. I’m very hesitant to comment on that because my No. 1 goal is Spencer’s career, his long-term health,”

Steve Nash on Spencer Dinwiddie, Mar 15, 2021. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Spencer Dinwiddie, Taurean Prince, Steve Nash
item.description:
Durant on Nash's presence:

“I think having Steve there and collaborating with our floor general every day is only gonna yield good results for our scorers like myself and Taurean, Caris and Spencer. Them having that relationship I think is gonna be key for us going forward.”

Kevin Durant on Spencer Dinwiddie, Taurean Prince, Steve Nash, Oct 1, 2020. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Kyrie Irving, DeAndre Jordan, Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
“We've got a new, fresh team with me, Kyrie Irving, DeAndre Jordan, Spencer Dinwiddie, a lot of guys on our team that our veterans,”

Kevin Durant on Kyrie Irving, DeAndre Jordan, Spencer Dinwiddie, Sep 10, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Chris Chiozza on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
More playmaking burden would fall on two-way player Chris Chiozza.

“With Spencer, I hope he can play. I hope he feels better,”

Chris Chiozza on Spencer Dinwiddie, Jul 6, 2020. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
“It’s going to take time for Kyrie to completely understand what we’re doing on both sides of the ball. That being said, for not understanding he’s been pretty darn good. “So it just gives us a lot of different options. I think about Spencer playing so well right now, when Kyrie comes back what does that look like? Is Spencer coming to start? You have [Temple] with the defense. There’s a lot [of options] … which is a good problem to have.”

Kenny Atkinson on Spencer Dinwiddie, Nov 25, 2019. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
“Kyrie is still learning exactly what we want to do. Spencer’s got a little more corporate knowledge,”

Kenny Atkinson on Spencer Dinwiddie, Nov 25, 2019. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Garrett Temple on DeAndre Jordan, Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
Garrett Temple:

“Kyrie just turned 27, so he still has another four or five years in his prime. The rest of the guys are so young – Spencer, Joe, Caris (who’s a really talented young guy), Jarrett. Then, you add in DeAndre, who’s a great vet, and KD coming back next year… There’s a lot to look forward to with this team.”

Garrett Temple on DeAndre Jordan, Spencer Dinwiddie, Jul 28, 2019. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Wilson Chandler on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
Wilson Chandler:

“We have so many great young players. is amazing and was looking so good before his injury and then came back strong too. Allen is a great defensive player, a great rim protector. Spencer is amazing and should’ve been in the race for Sixth Man of the Year. Taurean is really talented. A lot of the great pieces that we have around are guys who will just continue to grow.”

Wilson Chandler on Spencer Dinwiddie, Jul 28, 2019. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
As for the team he just finished coaching, Atkinson admitted he remains connected to the players, but understands he must move on.

“My romantic ideal is to develop our own and create a superstar from one of our draft picks or someone we acquire like the Spencer Dinwiddie’s,”

Kenny Atkinson on Spencer Dinwiddie, May 3, 2019. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
D'Angelo Russell on his chemistry with Spencer Dinwiddie:

“We’re winning. We’re winning, so I would say give credit to Coach. It’s not an easy thing to do when you have two dominant ball-handlers, so I give credit to the coaching staff.”

D'Angelo Russell on Spencer Dinwiddie, Dec 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @APOOCH.

item.title: Andre Drummond on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
Andre Drummond on Spencer Dinwiddie:

“(He) has a personal vendetta every time we play him. He's trying to let us have it every time we play. Any time he sees the Pistons he comes after us. That's a great mindset for him to have. I know it's a big yr for him. I wish him the best.”

Andre Drummond on Spencer Dinwiddie, Nov 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Spencer Dinwiddie, D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Anthony Puccio:Kenny Atkinson on D'Angelo Russell's benching:

“I felt like those other guys came in and started to play great [Caris & Spencer].You just go with it as a coach. It was just a feel.”

Kenny Atkinson on Spencer Dinwiddie, D'Angelo Russell, Mar 31, 2018. Source: Twitter @APOOCH.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Stan van Gundy on #Pistons dealing Dinwiddie:

“Spencer was looking for more of an opportunity. We like Spencer a lot, had a good relationship with his agent; they asked us to make that trade, we did.”

Stan Van Gundy on Spencer Dinwiddie, Jan 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
Kenny Atkinson on officiating:

“Spencer had his own take on the refereeing on the fact he doesn’t feel you guys are getting the deserved respect that he thinks team should get, is this brought up in locker room, boiling over, a sentiment that kind of has been floating around.”

Kenny Atkinson on Spencer Dinwiddie, Jan 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @APOOCH.

item.title: PistonsStan Van Gundy on Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
#PistonsStan Van Gundy on if Spencer Dinwiddie will return this season:

“I think so but he’s probably another week or so from being 100 percent.”

PistonsStan Van Gundy on Spencer Dinwiddie, Mar 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.
